name: @vip/service-notify
description: Notification service (Phase 1, P1-8) — the Alert Engine. Consumes `incident.raised` off NATS JetStream (Incident contracts only — never the rule candidate), selects the tenant's matching channels, delivers a notification per channel (in-app + webhook in Phase 1), records a delivery log, and publishes `notification.sent|delivered|failed|acked`. Channel CRUD + delivery log + recipient ack via a permission-gated API. Every notification inherits the incident's correlationId. See docs/architecture/22-BOUNDED-CONTEXTS.md §12, docs/architecture/phase1/ALERT_ENGINE.md.
